selection_reason: The selected Fluent v004 and OpenFOAM v002 runs contain complete matched histories: 100 implicit Euler steps of 2 s on the same 2,000-cell geometry. Physical properties, time limits and numerical targets remained unchanged through the documented compatibility corrections. Earlier attempts are preserved. The selected figure v002 improves label readability.

preserved_evidence.description: The original OpenFOAM preparation expected V; the actual volume export is Vc. That preparation stopped before any time steps.
The original Fluent conversion produced a solid zone, but an inactive fluid-setting read stopped setup before any time steps. No saved recovery case or data is claimed.
Native constant-property settings use the canonical value option. An unused inactive duration setter was removed; the earlier zero-step attempt is retained.
The actual first 2 s state passed numerical checks. The native [W] report label required a parser correction; the first-step fields and recovery files are retained.
Root independently checked the actual first-step signed heat powers, energy storage and residual before the complete rerun.
The analytical proof permits a documented 5.7e-13 K floating-point discrepancy. The reference formula and source are unchanged.
Independent comparison maps all 404,000 audited native temperatures to the same cells and physical times.
Presentation changes wrap labels and space displayed units; previous figures remain preserved.
